summary.text: Catina Hamm is the Democratic candidate for North Carolina State Senate District 24 in the November 3, 2026 general election, challenging incumbent Danny Earl Britt (R).
She is a respiratory therapist and U.S. Army veteran, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Catina Hamm advanced to the general election after the Democratic primary was canceled.
Her campaign website says she has worked multiple jobs at once for much of her adult life, has navigated the public school system as a parent, and believes education funding must match student needs.
